key_rationale: While headline CPI at 5.02% has moderated, the persistence of food inflation at 6.56% and an output gap of +0.70% signal that the economy is operating above potential, necessitating continued vigilance. Given the risks of unanchored inflation expectations and the prevailing global volatility, I believe it is premature to ease our stance until inflation durably aligns with the 4.00% target.
